steps.caption: The grid feeds the site through the transformer by the street.
When the grid fails, the standby generators start.
Their noise spreads across the yard to the next lot.
Fuel comes in at the fill point and runs to the tank under each set.
The design keeps 12 hours of fuel on site.

camera: face-on to the plant yard from the street; slides to the sets, rises and pulls back to the fence and the next lot for the noise, closes in on the fuel line, then pulls back over the whole yard
